Genuine transparent background, preserve cream/white opaque artwork. Exact composition and positioning as supplied.

Use case: background-extraction. Extract ONLY the illustrated picture/landscape symbol on the lower ribbon of this approved badge. Make it an independent large, polished icon on genuine transparent alpha. Preserve the rich original style: chunky rounded dark-purple frame, warm cream picture paper, two softly shaded lavender mountains, white snow cap, pink sun, subtle purple tonal shading and friendly rounded corners. Straighten the frame so its top and bottom are horizontal and sides vertical; no perspective/tilt/curve (the app will align it to each ribbon). Crop close around the complete frame with small equal transparent margins. No ribbon, badge, lettering, WK, flower ornament or extra elements. The icon should look like the original approved illustrated picture symbol, not a generic flat SVG icon. One landscape picture icon only.

Use case: background-extraction. Extract ONLY the illustrated pencil on the lower ribbon of this approved badge. Make it a separate large polished icon on genuine transparent alpha. Preserve the chunky rounded deep-purple contour, golden yellow wooden pencil with rich warm shading and highlight, cream sharpened wood, dark-purple tip, lavender ferrule and round pink eraser. Keep diagonal lower-left tip to upper-right eraser, preserve the original friendly dimensional illustration. Include the two or three small purple writing accent strokes near the tip, as in the approved image. Crop close with small transparent margins. No ribbon, badge, suitcase, lettering, level text, crown or background. One illustrated pencil symbol only; no flat generic SVG substitute.
